pattern: (Could not get lock /var/lib/dpkg/lock-frontend|Resource temporarily unavailable.*dpkg|Unable to acquire the dpkg frontend lock)
explanation: Another package management process (such as unattended-upgrades) is actively locking the dpkg frontend database.

pattern: (dpkg was interrupted, you must manually run 'dpkg --configure -a'|Sub-process /usr/bin/dpkg returned an error code)
explanation: A prior package transaction was terminated abruptly before completing configuration hooks.

pattern: Hash Sum mismatch|Hashes of expected file do not match
remediation: sudo rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/* && sudo apt-get clean && sudo apt-get update
explanation: Locally cached repository metadata or package archives became desynchronized with upstream mirrors.

remediation: sudo gpg --keyserver keyserver.ubuntu.com --recv-keys {match_1} && sudo gpg --export --armor {match_1} | sudo tee /etc/apt/trusted.gpg.d/{match_1}.asc >/dev/null && sudo apt-get update
explanation: A third-party APT repository is missing the corresponding GPG public signature verification key.

pattern: Release file for .* is not valid yet \(invalid for another.*\)|Release file .* is expired
remediation: sudo timedatectl set-ntp true && sudo apt-get update
explanation: System clock skew caused APT to reject valid upstream Release files as expired or premature.

pattern: (You have held broken packages|Unmet dependencies\. Try 'apt --fix-broken install'|Depends: .* but it is not going to be installed)
explanation: Package dependency solver encountered mutually exclusive package versions or held broken packages.
AppArmor Mandatory Access Control profile denied access to the confined resource.
YAML indentation or syntax error in /etc/netplan/*.yaml prevented network configuration generation.
